subject: prd/tech-design-review
statement: The reviewer shall generate candidate findings through the four design-class lenses — contract quality (incl. partition honesty), coherence (incl. strawman detection and record-fed ALT fidelity), upstream alignment (Serves substance · PRD fidelity · principles honesty · incident matching · supersession integrity · record fidelity), and feasibility & completeness (appetite fit · shape implementability · testing strategy · seam economy · risks-with-verification · missing concerns) — each candidate tagged with its lens.
fit_criterion: seeded per-lens defects each caught by their lens (EVAL-6)
